name: Sergi
source:
One of the "blues" living in the Forbidden Zone. He is cool and calm, most of the time.

Sergi has family living outside of the Forbidden Zone, and wants to go there to meet them.

[spoiler]He was born in Laughter Land, and is the son of Leesha and Zacharia.[/spoiler]
